question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.
sql:
WITH player_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    CAST(debut AS DATE) as debut_date,
    CAST(final_game AS DATE) as final_date
  FROM player 
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''
),
raw_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM debut_date) as raw_y,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM debut_date) as raw_m,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM debut_date) as raw_d,
    final_date
  FROM player_dates
),
day_adjusted AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    raw_y,
    raw_m,
    raw_d,
    CASE WHEN raw_d < 0 THEN raw_m - 1 ELSE raw_m END as m_adj,
    CASE WHEN raw_d < 0 THEN raw_d + CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (DATE_TRUNC('month', final_date) - INTERVAL '1 day')) AS INTEGER) ELSE raw_d END as d_adj
  FROM raw_diff
),
final_adjusted AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    CASE WHEN m_adj < 0 THEN raw_y - 1 ELSE raw_y END as y_final,
    CASE WHEN m_adj < 0 THEN m_adj + 12 ELSE m_adj END as m_final,
    d_adj as d_final
  FROM day_adjusted
),
career_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(y_final::DOUBLE), 2) + ROUND(ABS(m_final::DOUBLE) / 12, 2) + ROUND(ABS(d_final::DOUBLE) / 365, 2) as career_span
  FROM final_adjusted
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM career_spans
